atAGlance: Cơm bò lúc lắc is rice with shaking beef, usually with seared beef cubes, tomato, greens, onion, and lime-pepper salt.
whatItIs: Cơm bò lúc lắc is rice topped with seared beef cubes, onion or bell pepper, lettuce, tomato, and a lime-pepper salt dip. The beef should taste hot from the wok and slightly caramelized.
howToEnjoy: Dip the beef cubes lightly in lime-pepper salt, then eat with rice, tomato, and greens. Too much dip can hide the seared beef flavor.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm bò lúc lắc when you want shaking beef as a rice plate. Ask for less pepper, less onion, or lime-pepper salt on the side before the wok order lands.
worthKnowing: Lúc lắc refers to the shaking motion of the beef in the wok, a useful phrase to recognize on Vietnamese menus.
goodToKnow: Lime-pepper salt is for the beef cubes, while the rice catches the wok juices. Ask for onion or pepper changes before the beef hits the pan.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm bò lúc lắc.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of shaking beef with rice.
